title: Desert Horology Co.
tagline: Watch collecting, horological history, and honest buying advice
intro: Desert Horology Co. is my watch side of the internet. I collect, research, and make short videos about mechanical watches: the engineering inside them, the history behind them, and how to buy well without overpaying.
Start with the most-watched videos below, then follow along on Instagram for the newest ones.
_howToAddAReel: Easiest: run scripts/instagram-reels-snippet.js in your browser on your profile's Reels tab, then `pbpaste | node scripts/import-reels.js` (see docs/collect-reels.md). That fills featured[] with the top reels by views and series.episodes from captions. You can also add entries by hand: paste the link from Share > Copy link into url; topic is the small label above the title. Entries without a valid instagram.com/reel/... or /p/... link are skipped. With INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN configured, the API ranks videos live and this list is ignored.

series.name: The Quartz Crisis
series.description: A multi-part series on the 1970s and 80s upheaval that nearly ended Swiss mechanical watchmaking, told one episode at a time.
series._howToAddAnEpisode: With the API configured, episodes are detected from captions that contain the match phrase and ordered by the part number in the caption (e.g. "Part 03"). Without the API, list them here as { "part": 1, "title": "The Beginning", "url": "https://www.instagram.com/reel/..." }. The section stays hidden until at least one episode exists.
